items.title: Better Markets warns election event contracts are a huge gamble in fact sheet released one week before midterms
items.content_text: - **Better Markets warns election event contracts are a huge gamble in fact sheet released one week before midterms** — Better Markets issued a fact sheet on October 28 arguing election event contracts offer almost no public benefit and are susceptible to manipulation, especially in low-volume down-ballot races. Director Benjamin Schiffrin said a small bet could shift odds significantly and create an illusion of support, citing a Wisconsin primary example where a candidate priced at 95.9 percent lost. ([Better Markets](https://bettermarkets.org/newsroom/event-contracts-on-election-outcomes-are-a-huge-gamble/))
